offer.text: The dead walk thick tonight. Stand the watch with me — put down 4 zombies before dawn.

accept.text: Keep your back to the wall and your blade up.

decline.text: Then bar your door and let the watch handle it.

in_progress.text: How many have you dropped tonight?

ready.text: Four down before sunrise. The village slept safe and never knew.

complete.text: You'd make a fine soldier of the watch. Well held.
